$comment: Closed local telemetry schema, v1. Events are written locally to state/telemetry/events.jsonl. No network sending exists in this kit.

run.note: pseudo-random run id, not derived from the machine or the person

exec_ms.note: execution time of the script step; bash branch has 1-second resolution

wait_ms.note: time spent waiting for a human; the scripts leave it null; an agent-side recorder is not implemented

status: local events only; receiver, HTTPS sending and dashboard are NOT implemented; full telemetry is NOT claimed
